svg.text: GlassBox — observability middleware for Agent Runs
One Run = one correlated, privacy-safe trace. Solid arrows: execution path. Blue arrows: observation data flow. Purple: verification loop.

g.text: untrusted client · sees evidence, holds no keys
↻ recovery: restart marks in-flight Runs cancelled + open spans endedReason=server_restart — never guessed closed
🛡 serve gate: conversation store (prompts/messages) is redacted on every read response — storage stays raw for the runner
untrusted execution · disposable container per turn · env allow-list, never argv
↻ on error: fails CLOSED to metadata

metadata_only (default: ids, timing, status, counts — no text) · safe_summary (opt-in: 4 bounded redacted fields) · reasoning_summary (opt-in: 240-char redacted reasoning summaries) · full/raw PROHIBITED by PRD, not merely unimplemented

observed fact (emitted at a seam) · derived diagnosis (pure function over stored facts — no LLM in this path) · evaluator judgement (fenced: scores only, provenance-stamped, can never overwrite a deterministic verdict)
VERIFY — observability closes into regression detection
saved from a real Run's evidence
an Agent config change, caught with receipts
Judge fence: LLM evaluators read only the redacted evaluation view, stamp evaluatorModel provenance on every score, and can never write a diagnosis or classify a regression.
Controls are roadmap, not product: nothing in GlassBox blocks or decides — it observes, explains, and verifies. Evidence before control.
★ instrumentation point (adapter at an existing seam)
🛡 enforcement (redaction gate · capture policy · serve gate)
↻ recovery / degradation behavior (failure never lies, telemetry never breaks the Run)
dashed border: trust boundary (untrusted client / untrusted execution)
solid gray arrows: execution path (starter kit, preserved) · blue: observation flow · purple: verify loop
raw content that must exist (conversation store, workspace files) never crosses to a served surface unredacted
